name: Image to Blender Auto
description: Queue image-to-Blender generation with automatic execution, limited repair attempts, 3MF export and preview; revise a successful job; or read workflow status. Job completion is asynchronous.

examples.prompt: Generate a model from C:\AI-Workflow-Auto\Input\reference.png, 100 mm tall.

image_path.description: For start: full PNG/JPEG path inside C:\AI-Workflow-Auto\Input. Otherwise empty.

instructions.description: User modeling requirements or revision request. Empty for status.

parent_job.description: For revise: exact ID of successful job. Otherwise empty.
